verdict.rationale: Xero's docs show direct AI-generated insight features (JAX AI reconciliation/categorization matching, AI invoicing via plain-language commands, AI bill-data extraction, 'instant answers' on cash flow/profit trends) which fit the story of AI-generated insights inside the product. However, these are narrow, first-party marketing claims with no independent/hands-on corroboration of insight quality or breadth, and much of the evidence pack is about developer APIs/MCP integration rather than in-product insights. Missing for 10: independent verification of JAX's insight accuracy, broader coverage of proactive suggestions beyond reconciliation/invoicing/bill entry, and hands-on user reports confirming these AI features work as described.
